evidence: src/main/java/gymmie/MainController.java: contains one small workout-start interaction that updates a button and status label.
src/main/resources/gymmie/view/MainWindow.fxml: provides a single dashboard with static stats, a workout plan, and a weekly goal.
checks.notes: The UI is polished but remains a small starter: one screen, one meaningful action, and no unnecessary domain feature set.

evidence: src/main/java/gymmie/App.java: loads /gymmie/view/MainWindow.fxml, applies the scene, and sets the Gymmie window title.
src/main/resources/gymmie/view/MainWindow.fxml: names gymmie.MainController, injects startWorkoutButton and workoutStatusLabel, and binds #handleStartWorkout.
src/main/resources/gymmie/css/gymmie.css: defines selectors for the FXML style classes and the button hover/disabled states.
checks.notes: Resource paths, controller names, injected IDs, action handlers, visible Gymmie content, and CSS classes agree exceptionally well; the navigation labels are intentionally presentational.

evidence: README.md: describes Gymmie as a JavaFX desktop dashboard and documents ./gradlew run, check, and shadowJar.
AGENTS.md: documents Java 25, JavaFX 25, Gradle 9.7.1, and the same Gradle commands used by the project.
checks.notes: Documentation is concise, accurate, and internally consistent; README omits some exact tool versions but does not misdescribe the repository.

evidence: src/main/java/gymmie/App.java and src/main/java/gymmie/Launcher.java: separate JavaFX application startup from the packaged entry point.
src/main/java/gymmie/MainController.java: keeps the only interaction logic in a focused controller.
src/main/resources/gymmie/view/MainWindow.fxml and src/main/resources/gymmie/css/gymmie.css: separate layout/content from presentation.
checks.notes: The starter is easy for a student to follow and extend; the dashboard data is intentionally hardcoded in FXML and navigation labels have no behavior yet.

summary: The repository is a coherent, small JavaFX starter with accurate documentation and a clear separation between startup, controller, FXML, and CSS.
